tested.moneyline: 2025-26, 1,137 games: our win chance matched the closing moneyline (log loss 571.8 vs 571.2). When the sim said 20-35% the team won 28%, 35-50% won 44%, 50-65% won 57%, 65-80% won 75%, 80%+ won 86%.
tested.spread: 2025-26: at the closing spread the sim's side won 51.3% (break-even 52.4%): a coin flip, shown for the range only.
tested.total: 2025-26: at the closing total the sim's side won 50.7%: a coin flip. Totals' ranges were 8% too wide until 11-06 (fixed).
tested.sq_lines: 2025-26, 1,179 games: where SQ's team totals differ from Vegas, the SQ side won 50.6% on totals and 51.8% on sides (break-even 52.4%). A different view, not an edge.
tested.props: 2025-26, 171,087 markets: sim + market together beat the market alone, slightly (CI clear of 0; best on steals, assists, blocks; worse on 3PM and rebounds). Best-price bets at EV 4%+: +4.4% (52,543 bets), but best price alone with no sim: +7.8%.
tested.first: Jan 20 - Apr 12 2026 (games never tuned on): the sim beat the closing first-basket market on the real scorer (+0.050, CI +0.032 to +0.068), first FG and first 3PT too. EV 10%+ bets: +5.3% (CI -10 to +20): positive, not proven.
tested.ladders: 2025-26, 992,132 alt-line and milestone rungs (pre-game prices): the sim alone was right on average (hit 37.3% vs sim 37.3%; books' prices say 40.8% with their margin); sim + books together at the best price: EV 20%+ rungs +8.7% (21,521 bets, CI +2.0 to +15.8), EV 10-20% about break-even, EV under 10% a loss. Thresholds picked on that season: confirm on new games.
